results.occurrenceRemarks: The individual in this photo was sourced from a market in Taizhou City, Zhejiang Province. With permission, we measured relevant information and took this photo on - site. Subsequently, this individual was sold by the vendor to a shark processing factory for processing. In China, Carcharodon carcharias was officially listed as a national second - class protected wild animal since 2018. However, due to ineffective supervision in some areas, the illegal fishing, retention, and trading of this species still persist. We did not obtain the relevant permits in laws to collect such specimens. All we could do was take an identification photo of it with the consent of the local people.
